findings.issue: Committed-looking build artifacts (minified bundles, dist assets) sit inside app/ with no .gitignore entry, and `npm start` runs the possibly-stale prebuilt server bundle
findings.suggestion: Add app/.gitignore covering dist/ and server/ (or a `clean` script), and make `npm start` depend on the fresh build so it can never run stale output

findings.issue: Unbounded Promise.all fan-out over every move record with no timeout/AbortSignal; one transient API hiccup turns the whole page into a 500
findings.suggestion: Add a small concurrency limiter (or reuse the per-pokemon move set), pass an AbortSignal to fetch, and fall back to per-move failure (render '—') instead of failing the loader

findings.issue: Debounce timer is never cleared on unmount and the search input's value is bound to loader data, so a landing debounced navigation can clobber typing or fire after leaving the route
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer on route unmount (cleanup in a useTask/useVisibleTask$ or clear on blur) and treat the input as uncontrolled after first render

findings.issue: EXCLUDED_TYPES set duplicated in two modules; the three resource pages also repeat a near-identical id→CardData card-building loop
findings.suggestion: Export EXCLUDED_TYPES and a buildCards(ids) helper from lib/api.ts and reuse them

findings.issue: tsconfig is strict but nothing ever type-checks; loaders use `any` throughout, and the app has no unit tests for the trickiest pure logic (compareValues, humanize, min-level dedup)
findings.suggestion: Add `typecheck: tsc --noEmit` and a few unit tests for lib/format.ts and the moves-table comparator; introduce light interfaces for the API records in lib/api.ts

findings.issue: A routeLoader$ is declared solely to call status(404)
findings.suggestion: Use `export const onRequest: RequestHandler = ({ status }) => status(404)` — the documented middleware primitive for this

findings.location: app/src/components/not-found.tsx:6 vs app/src/routes/layout.tsx:8-11 and all card/link lists
findings.issue: Inconsistent internal-link primitives: Link in one component, raw <a> everywhere else
findings.suggestion: Pick one (Link gives explicit prefetch control) and use it consistently

findings.issue: Selects are driven by <option selected> per option instead of a value on <select>
findings.suggestion: Set value={d.filters.type} (etc.) on the <select> — clearer and less markup churn on re-render

summary: A genuinely idiomatic, current-release Qwik City app: all data through routeLoader$, state in the URL, a clean server boundary and a server entry that matches the official node-server starter. Merge blockers are hygiene, not architecture: build artifacts inside app/ with no .gitignore, unbounded move-fetch fan-out, and a debounce timer that outlives its component. I'd approve after one round of small, mechanical fixes.
